image_description: A close-up, side-profile view of a bison's head and upper forequarters against a snowy background. The bison has thick, dark brown shaggy fur, a prominent shoulder hump, and a visible short, curved horn. The eye is dark and partially obscured by fur. A portion of the front leg is visible, covered in fur.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The head is visibly large and broad relative to the frame. One short, curved horn is clearly visible and matches the description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Beard of long hair on chin and throat.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Long, shaggy hair is visible hanging from the chin and throat area, consistent with a bison beard.
The visible eye is dark and surrounded by fur.
No prominent external ear structure is visible; the area where the ear would be is covered by thick fur, matching the 'hidden' description.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image is a tight crop focusing on the head and neck. The full body proportions and withers height cannot be fully assessed due to framing.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Shaggy dark brown fur covering forequarters forming prominent shoulder hump.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The fur is visibly shaggy and dark brown. The curvature of the neck into the shoulder suggests the presence of the characteristic hump, though the full extent is cropped.
The hindquarters are completely outside the frame.

Only the very top of the front leg/shoulder area is visible. The lower legs and hooves are not in the frame.
The tail is not visible in this head-and-shoulders crop.

artifact_observations.reasoning: Slight softness and minor blending/haloing where the dark fur meets the bright white snow, particularly around the chin beard. This is common in AI generation but could also be depth-of-field blur. It lacks the crisp separation of a high-end photograph.

The transition from the neck/chest fur to the visible front leg is somewhat indistinct. The leg appears to emerge from the fur without a clear joint definition or anatomical clarity, looking slightly 'melted' into the body mass.
